support.claim: Summary: The meeting covered support ticket issues, site performance, quarterly budget, sales, and retention metrics.
support.reason: The meeting discussed support tickets, site performance, quarterly budget, sales, and retention metrics as stated in the transcript.

support.claim: Key point: Unresolved support tickets: 390 (current), 233 (last week)
support.reason: The cited text states the number of unattended support tickets is 390 currently and was 233 last week.

support.claim: Key point: Site performance improved: 950ms page load time (current), 820ms (previous release)
support.reason: The cited text states the current page load time is 950ms and the previous release was 820ms.

support.claim: Key point: Quarterly budget: Approved budget is $42,500 (current), $59,500 (previous quarter)
support.reason: The cited text states the approved budget is 42,500 dollars currently and 59,500 dollars in the previous quarter.

support.claim: Key point: Monthly sales: $354,000 (current), $134,000 (previous month)
support.reason: The cited text states the monthly sales are $354,000 currently and $134,000 previously.

support.claim: Key point: Retention: 34% trial user re-engagement rate (current), 82% (previous month)
support.reason: The cited text states the 2-week trial user retention rate is 34% and the previous month's rate was 82%.

support.claim: Key point: Retention trends largely matched expectations, with customer feedback highlighting the need for further discussion
support.reason: The transcript states retention trends were largely as expected and that customer feedback on retention was mentioned but lightly touched upon.

support.claim: Key point: Recruitment numbers are stable, with 75 candidates under consideration compared to 85 last month
support.reason: The cited text states there are 75 current candidates and that last month there were 85, and that recruitment trends are stable.

support.claim: Key point: Trial registration numbers are higher this month (4,650) compared to last month (2,600)
support.reason: The transcript states the current month's trial registration number is 4650 and last month's is 2600.

support.claim: Decision: Agree to use new website logo
support.reason: The meeting agreed to use a new logo on the website.

support.claim: Decision: Onboarding checklists will be retained
support.reason: The meeting explicitly decided to retain the onboarding checklists.

support.claim: Decision: The next meeting will be rescheduled to Thursday
support.reason: The meeting was decided to be moved to Thursday.

support.claim: Decision: The roadmap will be shared with customers
support.reason: The roadmap will be shared with customers was explicitly decided in the transcript.
